_note: Special start setups. A scenario is an override object for newGame(). Fields not given keep the value from balance.json. See README.md.

scenarios.name: Kitchen Start
scenarios.pitch: The normal game. You pick where to start. One rival, MegaCorp.
scenarios.tip: Spend your first Hype Points on growth. MegaCorp is slow to wake up.

scenarios.name: Tiny Island
scenarios.pitch: You start in Oceania: rich, online, and only 45 million people. Everyone there loves you. Now get off the island before TrendLab copies you.
scenarios.tip: Your home is too small to win from. Global Shipping or TV Ads get you to the big regions.

scenarios.name: Broke Genius
scenarios.pitch: Your product is amazing and your can looks great. But you only have $120k. Every upgrade with upkeep is a risk.
scenarios.tip: Smart Factory first. Watch your cash every day. Premium price can save you.

scenarios.name: They Got There First
scenarios.pitch: Heritage Brands already has shops everywhere, and its copy is already 15% done. You start in South America with a patent and a pile of Hype Points.
scenarios.tip: Do not get stuck. Every new region slows Heritage down. Local Flavors opens their walls.

scenarios.name: Three-Way War
scenarios.pitch: All three rivals at once. Each has its own copy bar. If any bar hits 100, you lose. You win at 42% of the world, because three rivals take a big part of it.
scenarios.tip: Know who is the biggest danger right now. Lawyers hit only one rival: the one with the highest bar.
